elements.requirement: Sections 18 to 30B 30I of, and the Schedule to, the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 (relating to service charges, insurance, managing agents, and building safety) apply in relation to Crown land as they apply in relation to other land.
elements.quote: The following provisions apply in relation to Crown land (as in relation to other land)— (a) sections 18 to 30B 30I of (and the Schedule to) the 1985 Act (service charges, insurance and managing agents and building safety)

elements.requirement: Part 2 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1987 (concerning appointment of a manager by the appropriate tribunal) applies in relation to Crown land as it applies in relation to other land.

elements.requirement: Part 4 of the Landlord and Tenant Act 1987 (concerning variation of leases) applies in relation to Crown land as it applies in relation to other land.
elements.quote: Part 4 of the 1987 Act (variation of leases)

elements.requirement: Chapter 5 of Part 1 of the Leasehold Reform, Housing and Urban Development Act 1993 (concerning management audit) applies in relation to Crown land as it applies in relation to other land.
elements.quote: Chapter 5 of Part 1 of the 1993 Act (management audit)

elements.requirement: Section 81 of the Housing Act 1996 (concerning restrictions on termination of tenancy for failure to pay service charges etc.) applies in relation to Crown land as it applies in relation to other land.

elements.requirement: Section 84 of, and Schedule 4 to, the Housing Act 1996 (concerning the right to appoint a surveyor) apply in relation to Crown land as they apply in relation to other land.

elements.requirement: The provisions in Chapter 5 of Part 2 of the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002 that relate to any of the provisions listed in paragraphs (a) to (g), as well as Part 1 of Schedule 11 and sections 164 to 171, apply in relation to Crown land as they apply in relation to other land.
elements.quote: in this Chapter, the provisions relating to any of the provisions within paragraphs (a) to (g), Part 1 of Schedule 11 and sections 164 to 171.

elements.requirement: Land qualifies as Crown land if an interest or estate in the land is or has at any time been comprised in the Crown Estate.
elements.quote: Land is Crown land if there is or has at any time been an interest or estate in the land— (a) comprised in the Crown Estate

elements.requirement: Land qualifies as Crown land if an interest or estate in the land is or has at any time belonged to Her Majesty in right of the Duchy of Lancaster.
elements.quote: belonging to Her Majesty in right of the Duchy of Lancaster

elements.requirement: Land qualifies as Crown land if an interest or estate in the land is or has at any time belonged to the Duchy of Cornwall.
elements.quote: belonging to the Duchy of Cornwall

elements.requirement: Land qualifies as Crown land if an interest or estate in the land is or has at any time belonged to a government department or been held on behalf of Her Majesty for the purposes of a government department.
elements.quote: belonging to a government department or held on behalf of Her Majesty for the purposes of a government department.

elements.requirement: A failure by the Crown to perform a duty imposed by or by virtue of sections 21 to 23A of, or paragraphs 2 to 4A of the Schedule to, the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 does not make the Crown criminally liable.
elements.quote: No failure by the Crown to perform a duty imposed by or by virtue of any of sections 21 to 23A of, or any of paragraphs 2 to 4A of the Schedule to, the 1985 Act makes the Crown criminally liable

elements.requirement: The High Court may declare any failure by the Crown without reasonable excuse to perform a duty imposed by or by virtue of sections 21 to 23A of, or paragraphs 2 to 4A of the Schedule to, the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 to be unlawful.
elements.quote: the High Court may declare any such failure without reasonable excuse to be unlawful.

elements.requirement: Any sum payable under any of the provisions mentioned in section 172(1) by the Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster may be raised and paid under section 25 of the Duchy of Lancaster Act 1817 as an expense incurred in improvement of land belonging to Her Majesty in right of the Duchy.
elements.quote: Any sum payable under any of the provisions mentioned in subsection (1) by the Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster may be raised and paid under section 25 of the Duchy of Lancaster Act 1817 (c. 97) as an expense incurred in improvement of land belonging to Her Majesty in right of the Duchy.

elements.requirement: Any sum payable under any of the provisions mentioned in section 172(1) by the Duke of Cornwall, or any other possessor for the time being of the Duchy of Cornwall, may be raised and paid under section 8 of the Duchy of Cornwall Management Act 1863 as an expense incurred in permanently improving the possessions of the Duchy.
elements.quote: Any sum payable under any such provision by the Duke of Cornwall (or any other possessor for the time being of the Duchy of Cornwall) may be raised and paid under section 8 of the Duchy of Cornwall Management Act 1863 (c. 49) as an expense incurred in permanently improving the possessions of the Duchy.
